name: phil/slides
description: Slides in Symfony from a UJO document or Markdown: speaker notes kept from the audience, a presenter view, keyboard navigation and PDF export.

suggest.phil/paged-media-bundle: For DeckPdf, the PDF of a deck through the configured print engine
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipe Button the templates draw their buttons and links with, through the Symfony UX Toolkit; or the Button of the Shadcn kit, with phil/ux-kit-shadcn
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: For the Stimulus controllers and the stylesheet, served without a build step
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: For the role the presenter routes ask for; without an authorization checker they are refused to everyone
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: For the controllers registered from assets/controllers.json
suggest.symfony/translation: For the labels of the templates in English and French
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the templates, the Twig functions and DeckPrint
